candidates.title: Böschung 01 · Feuchter Lehmhumus
candidates.direction: The balanced base option: finely crumbled moist woodland loam, compact earth between small irregular aggregates, cool grey-brown with natural darker damp interstices; almost no stones or vegetation. Gentle and cohesive.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE production source texture for a shallow woodland pond bank in the 2D top-down game Fragdachse.
Input reference: the attached screenshot is only a palette and art-style reference. Match its subdued dark woodland grass, brown earth and deep cool pond surroundings. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot or include its water shape, trees, rocks, base, UI, fog, characters or lighting effects.
Camera: absolutely vertical orthographic 90-degree TOP DOWN. A shallow naturally sloping bank viewed directly from above, NEVER a side view, cross-section, cliff face, extruded turf slab or isometric cutaway. The bank is soil grading toward moisture, not a stone wall.
Art: finely authored painterly-realistic game texture, matte, diffuse neutral illumination, natural small-scale material forms and quiet broad variation. No baked directional cast shadow or bright edge rim; slight natural material occlusion only. Restrained detail suitable for a dark forest arena, no photographic oversharpening or noise blanket.
Colour family: muted umber and brown-grey #554939 / #403a30, cool damp earth #30372f / #242f2b, subdued moss and grass #2b3b2c. Avoid orange/red clay, bright sandy beach, white pebbles and saturated green. Bank should bridge the existing brown/green ground and dark teal water without painting water into the asset.
Scale: 32 WORLD pixels per metre when eventually used. Soil grains and aggregates about 1–5cm, few embedded pebbles only 2–6cm, fine short root fibres, occasional tiny crushed leaf flecks. No large stones, dense foliage, flowers, tall reeds, driftwood, long roots, foam or ripples. No text, labels, border or collage.
Output a SQUARE fully OPAQUE seamless material tile, filled edge to edge with only bank material, naturally repeatable on both axes with no seam or obvious repeating motif. This is a direction-neutral material SOURCE to be clipped later to an arbitrary shoreline, not a complete pond and not a pre-shaped bank ring. Entire tile depicts an 8m by 8m patch, intended to be reduced to 256 by 256 world pixels. It must work anywhere inside a narrow bank mask.
Variant: The balanced base option: finely crumbled moist woodland loam, compact earth between small irregular aggregates, cool grey-brown with natural darker damp interstices; almost no stones or vegetation. Gentle and cohesive.
